source: Project-authored finite-ejection RC illustration; no paper waveform points or source code copied
qualification: Unqualified teaching source; no valve notch, reflections, CVP mean response, independent right-heart source or pressure numerics

units.pressure: Q32.32 centi-mmHg, raw-int16 centi-mmHg on acquisition
units.ejection_equilibrium: R*Q pressure increment during constant finite ejection, not full pressure or stroke volume

kernel.integer_power: cached coefficient squares; nearest-ties-to-even after each Q62 product
kernel.fractional_step: linear interpolation of independently evaluated adjacent whole-step powers at integer-ns position
kernel.sum: initial response and all accepted finite-ejection responses in Int128/Q62; one final Q32 rounding
kernel.decay_horizon: 64*tau; reject unless computed whole-step decay is already zero in Q62
kernel.clock: model-owned kernel, independent of acquisition, presentation and call boundaries

bounds.ejection_duration: positive, at most one conducted ventricular period
bounds.pressure: 0 <= asymptote <= initial <= 32767 centi-mmHg; 0 <= ejection equilibrium; asymptote + ejection equilibrium <= 32767
